title: Add CyLab-style feedback with 'better choice' password suggestions that fulfill checklist items
description: Implement CyLab Password Meter style feedback: 1) Detect pet names and simple word transformations (mydogs->MyDog$), 2) Detect common passwords used as substrings (fluffy), 3) Flag digits only at end vs middle, 4) Generate 'A better choice' suggestion that fixes the identified issues by inserting characters into middle positions. Example: MyDog$Fluffy99 -> M99yDtog$Fluffy
close_reason: Implemented CyLab-style feedback: pet name detection, common password substring detection, digit placement check, word transformation detection, and 'A better choice' password suggestion generator that moves digits to middle positions

title: Make 'A better choice' clickable and generate for all passwords scoring below 60
description: For any password scoring below 60, generate a 'better choice' suggestion that implements all checklist items correctly to score above 60. Make the suggestion clickable so users can apply it directly.
close_reason: Updated generateBetterChoice to create suggestions for ALL passwords scoring below 60. Suggestions implement checklist items (length 16+, uppercase, lowercase, digits in middle, symbols in middle) to score above 60. Made suggestion clickable - clicking applies the suggested password to the input field.

title: Fix quiz ranking ties and Key Takeaway modal
description: 1. Quiz ranks should differentiate passwords with same score (e.g., multiple 0s) using secondary criteria. 2. Key Takeaway section should be scrollable or modal.

title: Add CyLab dictionary word detection and feedback messages from cupslab/password_meter
description: Implement dictionary word detection using word lists from CyLab password_meter repo (https://github.com/cupslab/password_meter). Add feedback messages matching CyLab style: 'Don't use dictionary words (fireplace)', 'Make your password longer than 9 characters', 'Consider using 1 or more symbols'.
close_reason: Added comprehensive DICTIONARY_WORDS list based on CyLab password_meter repo, dictionary word detection with CyLab-style feedback messages (Don't use dictionary words), length feedback (Make your password longer than X characters), and character variety suggestions (Consider using 1 or more symbols)
